services.name: First house call
services.story: A house call after a car accident. Nothing is taken, and the office bills the auto claim its own way.

services_shape: visit types on a treatment table, each with a set length; a new patient's first visit is a history, an exam, and a first adjustment only if the chiropractor finds it safe; X-rays only when the chiropractor orders them; a care plan's visits are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes, and each is paid when it happens; a re-exam after each block of care
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 60-minute new patient visit)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a car accident or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), Medicare, or paying yourself
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, a sudden very bad headache, or sudden weakness, numbness, a drooping face or slurred speech

numbness in the groin or inner thighs, new trouble controlling the bladder or bowels, leg weakness that's getting worse, back pain with a fever, or a head injury or trouble walking after a crash or fall
first_steps: The claim for a car accident or work injury
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
The employer's OK for a workplace care day
license: always: each chiropractor holds their own active chiropractic license (DC) from the state where the patient is seen
staff_skills: chiropractors: exams, adjustments, reading X-rays, kinesio taping; prenatal care only by a chiropractor trained for it (here Dr. Chen); the front desk: check-in, plan checks, estimates and payment; only people cleared for house calls go to homes and workplaces
messages_never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results or the chiropractor's name (on a house call the chiropractor's name stays, for the door check); X-rays and results never go through Rosie
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
